title: Length of a filtered concatenation
statement: For natural numbers $m$ and $R$, concatenate $m$ copies of the Boolean value false for each $i<R$ satisfying $i<m$, and concatenate nothing for the other indices. The resulting list consists of $m\min(R,m)$ copies of false.
